title: Single-Variant Enums
pattern: Declaring an `enum` that only contains a single variant.
why_bad: Enums represent choice (sum types). A single-variant enum offers no choice, meaning a simple struct or direct type wrapper is simpler.
detection: An enum definition with exactly one variant.
counterexample: Enums designed to be extended incrementally during active, ongoing API design phases.
fix: Convert the enum into a standard struct or raw type.
source: Benjamin C. Pierce, *Types and Programming Languages* (2002); Fowler, *Refactoring*, Chapter 3.
